graph_decision.evidence: The analysis of the original displacement plots reveals a persistent step at J1 across all three axes (N, E, U), where the signal level shifts abruptly and remains at a new baseline. A transient event is clearly visible around J2, characterized by a sharp spike followed by a return to the previous trend; this corresponds to candidate pair P3 (J2-J3). The trajectory-subtracted plot confirms that J1 represents a permanent offset while J2/J3 represent a temporary excursion.
